checked_classes: Ordering errors — identity confirmation precedes collector preparation and observations; attribution follows observations, and independent review follows diagnosis.

Missing dependencies — the plan covers installed identity, bounded reproduction, correlated timings, hypothesis evaluation, remediation recommendations, and review; unavailable evidence must remain explicitly unresolved.
Ambiguous acceptance criteria — tasks identify concrete deliverables, measurement fields, operation limits, stop conditions, and dispositions for skipped observations or inconclusive results.
Scope smuggling — diagnostic artifacts and bounded operational reads serve the stated goals; fixes, instrumentation changes, dependency additions, and service interventions are excluded.

Constraint violations — probes are deferred to explicitly requested Execute; the plan prohibits product edits, product tests, inference requests, database record mutations, service changes, and restarts.
